title: ConnectorsList
description:
`connectors.list`'s reply (`connectors.json`).

```json
{"connectors": [{"id": "claude.ai Slack", "source": "claude.ai", "status": "connected",
  "tools": [{"name": "mcp__claude_ai_Slack__slack_search_public", "read_only_hint": true}],
  "checked_at": "2026-11-27T09:00:00.000Z", "identity": null}],
 "as_of": "2026-11-27T09:00:00.000Z", "from": "init", "model_turns": 0,
 "accounts": [{"account": 1, "label": null, "connectors": […],
   "as_of": "2026-11-27T09:00:00.000Z", "from": "init", "error": null}]}
```

accounts.description:
Every account's connectors, by slot: each account rlx knows, the plain one first.
With `account`, that account's alone.

as_of.description: When the plain account's connectors were last read, or `null` before they were.

connectors.description:
The plain account's connectors (slot 1, the plain `claude`), by `id`. Empty until
a run or a refresh has shown any.

from.description: Where the plain account's connectors were last read from.

model_turns.description: The model turns this call made: 0, or 1 for a one-turn refresh.

account.description:
The account's rlx slot: 1 for the default one, the plain `claude` on rlxd's own
environment.

as_of.description: When its connectors were last read, or `null` before they were.

connectors.description: Its connectors, by `id`. Empty until a run or a refresh has shown any.

error.description:
Why its latest refresh failed, or `null`: its connectors are then the ones read
before.

from.description: Where they were last read from.

label.description: The account's alias in rlx, when it has one.

checked_at.description:
When its status was last read: a run's `system/init`, a refresh, or a login's end.
Absent in a list saved before rlxd kept it.

id.description: Its name, as runs name it in `needs_connectors` and mounts: `claude.ai Slack`.

identity.description:
Who the account is on this connector (a Slack workspace and user, a Gmail
address), where rlxd has read it: `null` until then.

source.description:
Its kind, where it comes from: `claude.ai` for a claude.ai connector, else `mcp`
(a local MCP server).

tools.description: Its tools, as Claude Code mounted them.

ConnectorIdentity.description: Who an account is on one connector, as a read call of the connector's own said.

email.description: The address, such as a Gmail account's or a calendar owner's.

user.description: The user there, such as a Slack user's name.

workspace.description: The workspace or organisation, such as a Slack workspace's name.

ConnectorState.description: A connector's status, as Claude Code's `system/init` reports it.

oneOf.description: Its sign-in has lapsed: `connectors.login` signs in again.

name.description:
Its name, as a run's tool calls name it, such as
`mcp__claude_ai_Slack__slack_search_public`.

read_only_hint.description:
The tool's MCP `readOnlyHint`: `true`, `false`, or `null` when Claude Code doesn't
say. Always present.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Why a request was refused or failed.

code.description:
A stable, machine-readable code, such as `unauthorized`, `unknown_method`,
`incompatible_protocol`, `not_gate` or `not_a_tty`. A client also accepts codes it
does not know.

detail.description:
More about what went wrong: a string, such as an underlying error's text, or an
object whose fields the code defines, such as `incompatible_protocol`'s
`{"supported": [1]}` or `denied`'s `{"by": …}`. Never `null`: absent instead.

hint.description: What to do about it, for a person.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person.

oneOf.description: A `system/init`: a run's, or a one-turn refresh's.
A listing with no model turn (capability `connectors.no_turn`).
